test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.**

Jubilant
solution: The correct answer is: **Melancholic** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Jubilant **means feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph. (अत्यधिक ख़ुशी और विजय महसूस करना या व्यक्त करना) • **Example**: *The team was jubilant after winning the championship.* • Marked option **Melancholic **means feeling or expressing sadness or depression. (दुःख या अवसाद को महसूस करना या व्यक्त करना) • **Example**: *Despite the festivities, her face remained melancholic, revealing a hidden sorrow.* Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Indifferent **means having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned. (कोई विशेष रुचि या सहानुभूति न होना; उदासीन) • **Thoughtful **means showing consideration for the needs of other people. (अन्य लोगों की ज़रूरतों के प्रति विचार दिखाना) • **Gay **means happy and carefree. (खुश और लापरवाह) 179:T93d, The correct answer is: **Decoding**.
